name: Bambuddy
short_desc: Self-hosted command center for Bambu Lab 3D printers
author: maziggy
description: Bambuddy is a self-hosted, cloud-free command center for Bambu Lab 3D printers — from a single A1 to a large print farm. It talks to printers directly over the local network (Developer Mode), stores all print history locally, and adds scheduling, automation, notifications, server-side slicing and virtual-printer/proxy features. It uses host networking so it can discover printers via SSDP multicast and stream cameras.

form_fields.label: PUID
form_fields.hint: Host user id the container drops to (run `id -u`). Files in the data volume are owned by this user.

form_fields.label: PGID
form_fields.hint: Host group id the container drops to (run `id -g`).
